text: Hello boys and girls 我是来自普陀区上海荆州小学的很老师,you can call me Ms.Nice to teach you here.Are you ready for class?上课时,小朋友要 listen carefully, look carefully, speak loudly.First, let's read a rhyme with Danny and Alice.A book, a pencil, I can see.A book, a pencil, for you and me.A ruler, a rubber, I can see.A ruler, a rubber, for you and me.Good.Danny, Alice, Andy and Kitty are classmates.They are in the classroom.Look, their teacher Ms.Fong is coming.Hello children, look.Pencils, rulers, rubbers and a book.Let's count.How many pencils?One, two, three.Three pencils.How many rulers?One, two, three, four, five.Five rulers.How many books?One, one book.How many rubbers?One, two, three, four, five, six.Six rubbers.Look, one book, three pencils, five rulers, six rubbers.I can make a flower.How nice!原来,Ms.Fong用文具拼了一朵大大的花。让我们再来数一数她用了多少文具呀?Yes, one book.Look, one pencil, one ruler, one rubber, one.Look, this is the number one.Follow me.One, one.One book, one pencil, I can see.One book, one pencil, for you and me.One ruler, one rubber, I can see.One ruler, one rubber, for you and me.Let's listen to the chant.Children, do you like this chant?Let's read together.One book, how many pencils?Look, how many pencils?One, two, two pencils.Yes, one, one pencil.Yes, two pencils.This is the number two.Do you remember this rhyme?还记得这首儿歌吗?让我们一起来读一读吧。One tall girl and one short girl.How many girls?One, two, two girls.One fat boy and one thin boy.How many boys?One, two, two boys.Yes, two.One book, two pencils.Oh no, how many pencils?Yes, kitty, three pencils.Three.This is the number three.Look at my mouth.Look, here are some trees.How many trees?One, one tree.One, two, two trees.Three trees.Let's listen to a chant.Children, please raise your hand.Show me three.Yes, this is three.Read after me.Three, three, three.Three little trees.Sit like a tree.让我们像小树一样做得直直的。Let's try again.This time, please try to read with the teacher.请小朋友们跟录音里的老师和着节奏来试一试。Have a try.Super.One book, three pencils.Look, how many rulers?Yes, three rulers.Yes, two rulers.Let's count again.One, two, three, four.Yes, four rulers.Four.This is the number four.Well done.You are super.Four rulers.Oh no, how many rulers?Eddy.Yes, five.This is the number five.Five.Children, show me five.Yes, show me four.Show me five.Give me five.Do you know how?小朋友,当你们上课表现得很棒的时候,老师会走到你面前,伸出手说,Give me five.Right?Thank you.You are so good.Danny.Good, Danny.Children, let's count again.This is the number six.OK, now let's look at the flower again.下面请小朋友跟录音里的小朋友一起再来数一数,说一说。One book.You please.You try.OK, you are doing so well.Now please take out your workbook.请小朋友们把练习册打开。Turn to page 27.请翻到第27页。小朋友们,你们会听到录音里的老师提问。当你看到嘴巴的图标时,请你记得数一数回答。See, look, listen and answer.看图,听录音,回答问题。下面,横老师来问问录音里的小朋友。请电视机前的小朋友听一听,你们刚才的回答和他们一样吗?One, two, three, three rubbers.Six books.One, one pencil.One, two, three, four, four rulers.你们的回答跟他们一样吗?Big hands for you.Now, please close your workbook.It's your turn to speak.当你们看到这个小嘴的图标时,记得为他们配音朗读。Are you ready?Here we go.Hello, children.Look, pencils, rulers, rubbers and a book.Children, Ms.Fang can make a flower.She can sing a song too.Fang 高兴地唱起歌来。Please listen.I can make, I can make, I can make a flower.Three pencils, five rulers, one book and six rubbers.Do you like this song?Big hands for her.下节课,请小朋友们也准备好books, pencils, rulers and rubbers.We'll make and count.Goodbye, boys and girls.Hope to see you again.
